title: Write the no-code "time blindness" preset guide
note: Guide written from the app's real settings. Next: walk it once on a phone, then make the Reel and screenshot.
details: A five-minute guide for people who lose track of time: five presets using only settings that exist today, plus Reel and screenshot wording with no medical claims. The focus block itself waits until after the 4 Dec release.

docs.title: Set up Quando? for people who lose track of time
